info.name: StyleMind Identity — Manage Users US-02.07
info.description: Owner-approved Admin user-list, account-status, and complete-role replacement contract. Use only a disposable local database with dedicated verified fixture accounts. No credentials or tokens are embedded.

item.name: 01 - Sign in Admin A, Admin B and Customer C
Login A

exec: pm.test('Login A token response', function () { pm.expect(r).to.have.all.keys('access_token', 'refresh_token', 'token_type', 'expires_in'); pm.expect(r.token_type).to.eql('Bearer'); });

item.name: Identify A
Login B
Identify B
Login C
Identify C

exec: pm.test('C differs from A and B', function () { const id = pm.response.json().account_id; pm.expect(id).to.eql(pm.environment.get('accountIdC')); pm.expect(id).not.to.eql(pm.environment.get('accountIdA')); pm.expect(id).not.to.eql(pm.environment.get('accountIdB')); });

item.name: Filter ADMIN role without truncating complete roles

exec: pm.test('page fields and safe user representation', function () {
pm.test('every result contains ADMIN; all roles remain', function () { pm.response.json().items.forEach(function (u) { pm.expect(u.roles).to.include('ADMIN'); }); });

item.name: Filter by exact status and email substring

exec: pm.test('page fields and safe user representation', function () {

pm.test('email filter returns A only', function () { const p = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(p.items).to.have.length(1); pm.expect(p.items[0].email).to.eql(pm.environment.get('emailA').trim().toLowerCase()); });

item.name: Page 0 size 1

exec: pm.test('page fields and safe user representation', function () {
pm.test('page 0 metadata', function () { const p = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(p.page).to.eql(0); pm.expect(p.size).to.eql(1); pm.expect(p.total_elements).to.be.at.least(3); });

item.name: Page 1 size 1 is distinct

exec: pm.test('page fields and safe user representation', function () {
pm.test('stable page boundary', function () { const p = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(p.page).to.eql(1); pm.expect(p.items[0].account_id).not.to.eql(pm.collectionVariables.get('page0Id')); });

item.name: Unmatched email returns empty page

exec: pm.test('page fields and safe user representation', function () {
pm.test('empty result metadata', function () { const p = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(p.items).to.be.empty; pm.expect(p.total_elements).to.eql(0); pm.expect(p.total_pages).to.eql(0); });

item.name: Unknown list query is rejected

exec: pm.test('Problem Details code INVALID_REQUEST', function () { pm.expect(p.code).to.eql('INVALID_REQUEST'); pm.expect(p.status).to.eql(400); });

item.name: 03 - Non-admin denial and unchanged-state proofs
Snapshot all users before C status attempt

exec: pm.test('page fields and safe user representation', function () {

pm.collectionVariables.set('snapshotBefore', JSON.stringify(users.map(function (u) { return { account_id: u.account_id, email: u.email, account_status: u.account_status, email_verified_at: u.email_verified_at, registered_at: u.registered_at, roles: u.roles }; })));

item.name: Customer C cannot list users

exec: pm.test('Problem Details code ACCESS_DENIED', function () { pm.expect(p.code).to.eql('ACCESS_DENIED'); pm.expect(p.status).to.eql(403); });

item.name: Snapshot unchanged after denied C status

exec: const canonical = current.items.map(function (u) { return { account_id: u.account_id, email: u.email, account_status: u.account_status, email_verified_at: u.email_verified_at, registered_at: u.registered_at, roles: u.roles }; });
pm.test('rejected request left full user list unchanged', function () { pm.expect(JSON.stringify(canonical)).to.eql(pm.collectionVariables.get('snapshotBefore')); });

item.name: Previously issued access JWT still reaches baseline /me

exec: pm.test('old access JWT remains valid until exp', function () { pm.expect(pm.response.json().account_id).to.eql(pm.environment.get('accountIdC')); });
